Sidhant Sangle Navi Mumbai| 7620873229 | www.linkedin.com/in/sidhantsanglefin | sidhantsangle86@gmail.com

TREASURY & MARKET OPERATIONS ANALYST Liquidity & Regulatory Reporting | Fixed Income & derivatives Settlement | Collateral & CCIL Treasury and Markets Operations professional with 5+ years of experience across fixed income settlements, derivatives processing, liquidity management, reconciliations, and RBI regulatory reporting within global banking and market infrastructure environments. Experienced in trade lifecycle management, CCIL margining, risk monitoring, balance sheet reporting, and process automation. Proven record managing high-value exposures, improving controls, reducing manual intervention, and supporting front office, finance, and regulatory stakeholders.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Treasury & Markets Operations | Fixed Income & Gsec Settlements | Derivatives Processing | Trade Lifecycle Management | Collateral & Margin Management| Settlement Break Resolution | RBI Regulatory Reporting | Nostro / Cash Reconciliations | Risk & Limit Monitoring | GL Proofing | SWIFT Payment | Money Market Operations | Process Automation

EXPERIENCE

Citicorp Finance India Limited (Citibank), Mumbai Assistant Manager – Treasury and Market Operations (Immediate Joiner) Experience supporting fixed income and treasury operations, CCIL margining, RBI reporting, and liquidity controls

Nov 2022 – Jun 2026

Managed end-to-end settlement and post-trade lifecycle for USD 450M fixed income portfolio, sustaining 99.9% accuracy and minimizing settlement breaks. Investigated regulatory reporting breaks, rejections and data discrepancies. Performed reconciliation and root-cause analysis to resolve reporting issues.

• • Managed weekly KRI monitoring for 180+ exceptions, prioritized high-risk items and escalated issues, cutting resolution time by 20%.

Conducted reconciliations and GL proofing for USD 100M+ in trade balances, identified discrepancies, and



resolving settlement break within defined SLAs. Led manual touchpoint reduction across Treasury & Trade Services (TTS), coordinating 20+ quarterly full key automations across 6 upstream applications including Flexcube, and other Citi inhouse systems (USD 23M firm- wide initiative).

Worked with Trade Repository reporting processes, validating trade and transaction data, monitoring submissions, and ensuring accurate reporting throughout the trade lifecycle. • Coordinated with clients and internal teams to resolve reporting issues within SLAs. • Managed client workflows end-to-end, coordinating queries, issue resolution, and timely closure within

agreed SLAs. Coordinated with internal operations, technology and regulatory teams to investigate Trade Repository discrepancies, validate reporting data and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.

Managed Transaction Reporting activities across the trade lifecycle, performing trade data validation, reconciliation, exception investigation and resolution to ensure accurate and timely regulatory submissions.

Hands-on exposure to EMIR, MiFID/MiFIR, SFTR, ASIC, CFTC and SEC regulatory reporting requirements, supporting regulatory controls, data validation and reporting compliance across capital markets transactions.

Manage brokerage payments and vendor governance for 10+ brokers using P2P systems, performing concentration analysis, and annual KYC reviews.

Collaborated with Front Office teams (Sales & Trading desk) to correct economic parameters booked incorrectly preventing P&L impact and ensure accurate position reporting.

Hosted weekly calls with various stakeholders (Technology/Legal /Desk Assistants) to discuss all outstanding queries and ask for an ETA to get those resolved.

• Prepare and submit key RBI regulatory reports (ALCO, ALM, NDSI, CRILC), directly supporting balance sheet

controls and liquidity monitoring. Support front office decision-making through exposure monitoring, bond MIS and FX impact analysis.

• Manage CCIL limits, collateral obligations and onboarding of international counterparties to ensure seamless trade execution and daily liquidity funding.

Monitor coupon and dividend payments for FI bonds and G-Secs, reconciling with holdings and passing accounting entries to clear breaks promptly.

Metropolitan Clearing Corporation MCCIL, Mumbai 2022 Associate Managed clearing and settlement for various market segments including currency derivatives and debt

Mar 2022 - Oct

Assisted clearing and settlement across currency derivatives and debt markets within central counterparty environment.

Monitored settlement obligations, fund movement and risk controls supporting trade finality.

• Developed exposure to post-trade infrastructure, clearing operations and market risk controls.

Edelweiss Financial Services, Mumbai, India Junior Associate Supported wealth management operations for HNI clients, handling investment advisory and trade execution

Dec 2019 - Jul 2021

• Managed investor transaction processing, reporting and operational controls. • Facilitated product execution across mutual funds, insurance and investment solutions.

Supported transaction execution and operational servicing for HNI investment products.

PROJECTS



Key contributor in Project NEO (GMI sunset used to maintain initial margin and F&O trades) including UAT testing on ION XTP and worked on Confluence for system automation and initial margin / F&O trade migration.

Worked on Credit default swaps lifecycle step-up, settlement process, SSI creation with Citibank and ISDA documentation.

Delivered classroom trainings for new team members improving onboarding effectiveness and reducing error rates.

Contributed to automation of GL across treasury & trade services to reduce manual interventions

ACHIEVEMENTS

Conducted client specific classroom trainings for the new team members • Maintained 99.9% valuation/reconciliation accuracy • Supported regulatory reporting and liquidity monitoring across treasury operations

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Flexcube | CCIL platform | SQL |Microsoft office (Excel – Advanced) | Xceptor | GMI | ION XTP | P2P Platform | CBRICS

EDUCATION

MBA, Financial Management Sasmira Institute of Management Studies, Worli - Mumbai, India (2018 – 2020)

Bachelor of Management Studies, Marketing Tilak Junior College Vashi - Navi Mumbai (2015 – 2018)

SOCIAL IMPACT

Worked with a major government-sponsored initiative Mahalaxmi Saras awarded an Appreciation Certificate by the Government of India for outstanding contributions to organizing and executing the event.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
EXPERIENCE
Citicorp Finance India Limited (Citibank), Mumbai Assistant Manager – Treasury and Market Operations (Immediate Joiner) Experience supporting fixed income and treasury operations, CCIL margining, RBI reporting, and liquidity controls
Nov 2022 – Jun 2026
Managed end-to-end settlement and post-trade lifecycle for USD 450M fixed income portfolio, sustaining 99.9% accuracy and minimizing settlement breaks. Investigated regulatory reporting breaks, rejections and data discrepancies. Performed reconciliation and root-cause analysis to resolve reporting issues.
• • Managed weekly KRI monitoring for 180+ exceptions, prioritized high-risk items and escalated issues, cutting resolution time by 20%.
Conducted reconciliations and GL proofing for USD 100M+ in trade balances, identified discrepancies, and

resolving settlement break within defined SLAs. Led manual touchpoint reduction across Treasury & Trade Services (TTS), coordinating 20+ quarterly full key automations across 6 upstream applications including Flexcube, and other Citi inhouse systems (USD 23M firm- wide initiative).
Worked with Trade Repository reporting processes, validating trade and transaction data, monitoring submissions, and ensuring accurate reporting throughout the trade lifecycle. • Coordinated with clients and internal teams to resolve reporting issues within SLAs. • Managed client workflows end-to-end, coordinating queries, issue resolution, and timely closure within
agreed SLAs. Coordinated with internal operations, technology and regulatory teams to investigate Trade Repository discrepancies, validate reporting data and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
Managed Transaction Reporting activities across the trade lifecycle, performing trade data validation, reconciliation, exception investigation and resolution to ensure accurate and timely regulatory submissions.
Hands-on exposure to EMIR, MiFID/MiFIR, SFTR, ASIC, CFTC and SEC regulatory reporting requirements, supporting regulatory controls, data validation and reporting compliance across capital markets transactions.
Manage brokerage payments and vendor governance for 10+ brokers using P2P systems, performing concentration analysis, and annual KYC reviews.
Collaborated with Front Office teams (Sales & Trading desk) to correct economic parameters booked incorrectly preventing P&L impact and ensure accurate position reporting.
Hosted weekly calls with various stakeholders (Technology/Legal /Desk Assistants) to discuss all outstanding queries and ask for an ETA to get those resolved.
• Prepare and submit key RBI regulatory reports (ALCO, ALM, NDSI, CRILC), directly supporting balance sheet
controls and liquidity monitoring. Support front office decision-making through exposure monitoring, bond MIS and FX impact analysis.
• Manage CCIL limits, collateral obligations and onboarding of international counterparties to ensure seamless trade execution and daily liquidity funding.
Monitor coupon and dividend payments for FI bonds and G-Secs, reconciling with holdings and passing accounting entries to clear breaks promptly.
Metropolitan Clearing Corporation MCCIL, Mumbai 2022 Associate Managed clearing and settlement for various market segments including currency derivatives and debt
Mar 2022 - Oct
Assisted clearing and settlement across currency derivatives and debt markets within central counterparty environment.
Monitored settlement obligations, fund movement and risk controls supporting trade finality.
• Developed exposure to post-trade infrastructure, clearing operations and market risk controls.
Edelweiss Financial Services, Mumbai, India Junior Associate Supported wealth management operations for HNI clients, handling investment advisory and trade execution
Dec 2019 - Jul 2021
• Managed investor transaction processing, reporting and operational controls. • Facilitated product execution across mutual funds, insurance and investment solutions.
Supported transaction execution and operational servicing for HNI investment products.
